title: indigo_generator: generated coordinates handler sets OK before on_change, opening a window in the BUSY guard
description: Found on 2026-11-21 by reading the source while investigating ticket c3aeb19f-08e7-4d4b-a897-d9cf2002d6cf; not reproduced. The generated property handler sets the property state to INDIGO_OK_STATE on the queue thread before the on_change code runs (indigo_tools/indigo_generator.c about lines 1903-1905). For MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES a second request arriving in that window passes the BUSY guard of INDIGO_COPY_*_PROCESS_COORDINATES_CHANGE although the first request is still being handled. First establish whether it can be reproduced in a simulator suite and which properties are concerned; a generator change needs the owner's explicit approval of the concrete proposed diff and a statement of its impact on existing drivers.

outcome.summary:
Independent review (claude-opus-5-5, high) of f7daadc02. No blocking findings.
1) Generator: diff is exactly the approved condition '&& strcmp(property->id, "MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES")' plus a comment in write_c_property_change_handler(). Rebuilt master and worktree generators in scratch and regenerated all 120 non-template .driver files (git archive trees, cwd = driver dir): old generator on master = 0 diffs; new generator on master = only mount_lx200.c:4835, mount_nexstar.c:1131, mount_simulator.c:433 (one removed prologue line each); new generator on HEAD = 0 diffs vs checked-in outputs.
2) Paths without the prologue: mount_simulator (count=2 SYNC/TRACK): alignment sync -> indigo_mount_sync() sets OK or ALERT on every return (indigo_mount_driver.c:1322-1385), controller sync OK (:448), GoTo BUSY completed by position_handler (:452), parked -> reject. mount_nexstar: TRACK BUSY with goto_active completed by the queued poll, sync (guiding or not) now OK at .c:1138, nexstar_set_coordinates failure (incl. dev_id<0, not aligned) ALERT; poll is on the device queue and request_pending keeps it off the handler's BUSY. mount_lx200 (count=2): on_change wrote BUSY as first state before any I/O (meade_host_timed_guiding is a flag test), TRACK BUSY/ALERT, SYNC OK/ALERT, rejects via indigo_reject_coordinates_change(); behaviour unchanged. No path stays BUSY. The 7 unchanged generated drivers (ioptron, nexstaraux start with BUSY; pmc8, rainbow, starbook, temma, synscan have _finalizer) had no prologue; byte-identical output confirms.
3) Tests: built scratch copy; after fix PASS: simulator request_during_sync_handler + sync filter (4 cases), nexstar request_during_sync, sync filter (2), poll_in_flight, coordinates_publish, lx200 request_during_coordinates, park_rejects, generic_goto_polling. Re-adding only the prologue line to the generated simulator/nexstar .c reproduces the claimed failures: test_mount_simulator.c:1786 and test_mount_nexstar_simulator.c:1973. No existing as

history.text: Owner decision 2026-11-22: 'ok, oprav generator a skontroluj VSETKY mount drivery, ci sa ich to tyka'. Approved generator change, as described to the owner: for the property MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES the generated handler no longer writes INDIGO_OK_STATE before the on_change code, so the property stays BUSY from the admission of the request until the handler publishes its result; every driver whose on_change relied on that OK (paths that finish at once, e.g. a sync) sets OK itself. Review passed at f7daadc02. Report-only findings, not fixed (off-limit drivers): mount_asi and mount_mxhd have no BUSY guard at admission of MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES (a request during a GoTo overwrites its targets; mxhd never publishes a sync BUSY); system_ascol handles the request synchronously on the bus thread without a guard. | mount_starbook | generated | no (_finalizer) | n/a | no |
| mount_synscan | generated | no (_finalizer) | n/a | no (output byte-identical, not touched) |

| mount_asi (off limits, read only) | hand-written | no prologue, but no BUSY guard at admission at all: targets copied and handler queued unconditionally; BUSY set only inside mount_eq_coords_callback | a request during a running GoTo/sync overwrites the targets of the running one and is queued | not changed (off limits) |
| mount_mxhd (off limits, read only) | hand-written | same as mount_asi: no admission BUSY guard, targets copied unconditionally; a sync is never published BUSY | same | not changed (off limits) |
| system_ascol (off limits, read only) | hand-written | no admission BUSY guard; the request is handled synchronously on the bus thread (network I/O in change_property), sets OK before the TSRA/TGRA transaction and publishes ALERT through indigo_update_property() on unmet conditions | any request during a running slew is sent to the telescope | not changed (off limits) |
| system_alpaca mount | hand-written | no window: system_alpaca_accept() admits under the device mutex, refuses while BUSY (ALPACA_ACCEPT_ANYTIME + mount_coordinates_refusal), state stays BUSY until the handler publishes | none | no |
| indigo_libs base mount driver | library | handles only a passed-through sync synchronously in change_property (indigo_mount_sync + indigo_update_coordinates); no queue, no window | none | no |
| agent_mount, agent_alpaca | clients of a mount | do not own MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES handling | n/a | no |

REPRODUCTION (before the fix, unchanged generated drivers, under the shared lock)
- mount_simulator, new case mount_request_during_sync_handler_is_refused: an alignment-model (NEAREST_POINT) sync; the client callback that receives the alignment point the sync adds (delivered on the device queue inside the handler, bus mutex is recursive) makes a second sync request. Before: FAIL test_mount_simulator.c:1786 context.busy_message_count > messages, i.e. the second request was admitted (no "Sync refused, the mount is busy"); an earlier variant of the case also saw a second alignment point. After: PASS.
- mount_nexstar, new case nexstar_request_during_sync_is_refused: the simulator answers the precise sync ('s') 500 ms late (delay control); a second sync request sent while the handler waits for that answer. Before: FAIL test_mount_nexstar_simulator.c:1973 wait_for_busy_message_after (admitted). After: PASS.
- mount_lx200: the window only spanned the few statements between the prologue and the on_change BUSY assignment, no I/O, so it is not reproducible; new regression case lx200_request_during_coordinates_handler_is_refused (GoTo: request sent after :MS# reached the controller is refused with the BUSY message and never sent, GoTo publications stay BUSY until one OK at its target; a following sync likewise BUSY then OK) passes before and after.

GENERATOR (indigo_tools/indigo_generator.c, write_c_property_change_handler): the OK prologue condition gains && strcmp(property->id, "MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES") plus a two-line comment. Nothing else changed in generator, DSL, lifecycle or library.
Proof no other output changed: all 120 non-template .driver files were regenerated into a scratch tree (copied .driver + indigo_libs/*.c for the base scan) with the old generator (0 differences from the checked-in outputs) and with the new one: before the drivers were regenerated only mount_lx200.c, mount_nexstar.c, mount_simulator.c differed (each by exactly the removed prologue line); after regeneration in place, 0 differences over all 237 generated .c files and the .h files. The other drivers were regenerated only in scratch, not compiled; off-limit drivers have no .driver files and were not touched.

DOCS: DRIVER_GENERATOR_BASICS.md (Change handlers prologue rule, Mount/Coordinates bullet, known issue 12, known issue 3 sentence on BUSY coordinates now says they are refused through indigo_reject_change() with a BUSY message), DRIVER_GENERATOR_MIGRATION.md (MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES has no OK prologue; every on_change path sets its state). test_mount_simulator.c comment that described the state as briefly not BUSY inside the driver corrected.

TESTS: +1 hardware-free case each in test_mount_simulator.c, test_mount_nexstar_simulator.c, test_mount_lx200_simulator.c (above). 10x repeat of 11 affected cases (simulator: request_during_sync_handler, sync_publishes_busy_and_keeps_a_refusal, sync_during_goto_is_refused_with_busy_message, goto_runs_on_queue_and_rejects_overlap, alignment_model_is_frozen_during_slew; nexstar: request_during_sync, tracks_syncs_and_aborts_coordinate_changes, coordinates_publish_the_mount_position, poll_in_flight_does_not_complete_goto; lx200: request_during_coordinates_handler, park_rejects_motion_and_unpark_recovers): 110/110 passed.
